weeks.note: Eight days, and the recovery week. Less riding means less ride fuel and smaller portions — this is the cheapest week per day of the block.

fuel: 5 level tbsp table sugar, 1/4 tsp salt, squeeze of lemon. Fill a 500 ml bottle and shake. About 8¢. Saturday wants three plus solid food.
2 cups cooked short-grain white rice, 2 tbsp honey, 1 tbsp peanut butter, pinch of salt. Mix warm, press into a pan, chill, cut into six, wrap in foil. 200 kcal and 38 g carb each, about 20¢.
60–90 g carbohydrate per hour past 90 minutes. 20–28 oz fluid per hour. 500–800 mg sodium per hour past two hours or on a hot day.
